management_notes: Leadership transition in May 2026 saw Tasheel Jeerh appointed CEO to 'accelerate strategic growth' — a signal of board intent to move faster on project advancement. The team's subsequent Golden Baie option deal and active Spring 2026 drill program demonstrate execution follow-through. Still limited verifiable insider-ownership disclosure and no institutional-led financing that would signal strong management conviction, but the operational cadence has improved materially since late 2025.
geology_notes: The 2025 maiden drilling at Black Raven delivered a standout intercept of 7.25% Sb over 1.98m near the Southern Shaft along an 800m strike — high-tenor antimony that confirms the district hosts economic-grade mineralization. A correction to the March 2026 release (issued May 2026) addressed compilation discrepancies, and nine additional 2026 drill holes were completed with assays pending as of May. August 2026 final results from the Spring drill program were published. Golden Baie (optioned Feb/Mar 2026) adds a second antimony-gold land package in central Newfoundland. No NI 43-101 resource estimate has been published yet — the August 2023 technical report remains the most recent filed. Score raised from prior runs reflecting confirmed high-grade drill results and expanded land position; still penalized for absence of a formal resource.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares issued and outstanding is a heavy float for a company still at the resource-delineation stage. Fully diluted count of 342.8M adds ~26M in warrants (2.625M) and options (23.45M); strike prices and expiry dates were not extracted from the MD&A (April 2026 filing). The Golden Baie option agreement may have required share issuance as partial consideration, potentially adding to the outstanding count since the April 2026 MD&A was filed — exact post-deal share structure is not available in the extracted data. No flow-through financing history detected in the extracted data or extraction notes. The large share count continues to compress per-share NAV optionality.
catalyst_notes: Several near-term catalysts are in motion: (1) pending assay results from additional 2026 drill holes at Black Raven, with Spring results already released August 2026; (2) Golden Baie option milestones (exploration or resource work required to earn 100%); (3) any NI 43-101 resource estimate update would be a material re-rating event. The macro backdrop is as strong as it has been — Canada, the US, the EU, and Australia all classify antimony as a critical mineral, Chinese export restrictions (implemented late 2024) remain in force, and Western battery/military demand continues to grow. Churchill is one of only a handful of advanced Canadian antimony projects, which keeps strategic-buyer interest elevated.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, making P/NAV calculation impossible. The high-grade 7.25% Sb drill intercept and expanded land package (Golden Baie) are directionally positive for strategic value, but without defined tonnage and grade, any M&A benchmarking remains speculative. The critical-mineral designation and Chinese supply-chain risk keep strategic buyer interest high — this is the upside optionality. Score held at 2 until a resource estimate is published that allows proper comparable-transaction valuation.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources has made tangible operational progress since early 2026: a new CEO (Tasheel Jeerh, May 2026), a confirmed high-grade antimony intercept (7.25% Sb over 1.98m at Black Raven), acquisition of a second Newfoundland antimony-gold property (Golden Baie, optioned February 2026), and an active 2026 drill program with results through August. The antimony macro thesis — critical-mineral designations, Chinese export controls, battery and military demand — remains intact and may be strengthening. However, with 316.7M shares outstanding, no published NI 43-101 resource estimate, and assay results still pending from the most recent holes, the risk/reward does not yet support a BUY. WATCH pending a resource estimate release, positive assay results from the 2026 program, or a strategic transaction that re-rates the asset.
